description: Source code for hiredis's read.c, implementing Redis protocol parsing and error handling functions.

methods.name: __redisReaderSetError
methods.description: Sets an error state in the redisReader, freeing previous reply object and clearing buffer.

methods.name: chrtos
methods.description: Converts a character to a string representation, escaping special characters.

methods.name: __redisReaderSetErrorProtocolByte
methods.description: Sets protocol error based on an unexpected reply type byte.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the buffer if available.

methods.name: seekNewline
methods.description: Finds the position of \r\n in a string.

methods.name: string2ll
methods.description: Converts a string to a long long integer with strict validation.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line terminated by \r\n from the buffer.

methods.name: moveToNextTask
methods.description: Advances the parsing task stack to the next item.

methods.name: processLineItem
methods.description: Processes a line-based reply item based on its type.

methods.name: processBulkItem
methods.description: Processes a bulk string reply item.

methods.name: redisReaderGrow
methods.description: Grows the task stack for nested reply parsing.

methods.name: processAggregateItem
methods.description: Processes array, map, and set reply types.

methods.name: processItem
methods.description: Processes a single reply item based on its type byte.

methods.name: redisReaderCreateWithFunctions
methods.description: Creates a redisReader with custom reply object functions.

methods.name: redisReaderFeed
methods.description: Feeds data into the redisReader buffer for parsing.

methods.name: redisReaderGetReply
methods.description: Attempts to parse and retrieve a reply object from the buffer.
